versions.content: If data is transmitted using a socket which is bound to an IPv4 Unicast local address (TcpIpAddrId) the TcpIp shall use the IP address assigned to the local address (TcpIpAddrId) as source IP address in the IP datagram header. The IP datagram shall be transmitted using the EthIfCtrl the local address (TcpIpAddrId) is m apped to.
